WebSearch for "Fritanga la Trinitena"/"Fritanga Trinitena" Miami found no official website, no Instagram, no Facebook page; only unrelated Nicaraguan fritanga restaurants (Fritanga Monimbo, Fritanga Managuita, Fritanga Cana Brava) turned up, none matching this food truck.

email_search_note: No email found. No website, no Instagram/Facebook profile located despite two targeted WebSearch passes. Only public contact channel is the phone number from the Google Business Profile (also usable for SMS/WhatsApp).

reviews_verbatim_google.author: Alfredo Palmer
reviews_verbatim_google.text: Amazing food! Highly recommend it. They have good pricing too

reviews_verbatim_google.author: amilly alvarez
reviews_verbatim_google.text: Carne asada was on point. Tender and well seasoned. The tajadas and fresh Pico de Gallo were fire. I'd recommend.

reviews_verbatim_google.author: AM Eventos Ciudad del Sol
reviews_verbatim_google.text: Congratulations, the food is delicious, highly recommended, everything from the freshness to the service. There were 6 of us and everyone was happy.

reviews_verbatim_google.author: Alvin Monge
reviews_verbatim_google.text: Great service, delicious food. Open Wednesday to Monday from 7:00 PM to 12:00 AM.

menu_note: No published menu or prices found anywhere (no website, no delivery-app listing, no social media). Reviews confirm real dishes (carne asada, tajadas/fried plantains, fresh pico de gallo, 100% Nicaraguan food) but per the hard rule against fabricating a price list, this could only have shipped as a 'variante adaptada' with a specialties-from-reviews section and no prices.
fail_reason: Solo 4 fotos reales y propias del negocio disponibles en total (Google Maps Business Profile, via scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js y scripts/gmaps_detail.js, ambos agotados, con 1 foto superpuesta entre los dos metodos). No existe Instagram ni Facebook del negocio (2 busquedas web dirigidas no encontraron ningun perfil, solo listados de OTROS fritangas de Miami sin relacion). Por FORGE-BRIEF.md seccion 0.b, el minimo duro es 5 fotos reales y propias; este negocio no lo alcanza y el research no esta degradado (se probaron los 2 metodos de Maps mas 2 busquedas web especificas). Las 4 fotos disponibles SI son genuinas y de buena calidad (2 platos de comida, 1 foto atmosferica del food truck con arcoiris al atardecer, 1 foto frontal del truck con el letrero 'FRITANGA TRINITEÑA'), guardadas en assets/raw/ para la proxima corrida por si aparece una quinta foto (nueva subida a Google, o si el negocio abre redes sociales).
